meta.title: ci: optimize turbo build and test performance
meta.body_summary: Optimize CI turbo build and test workflows by adding parallelism flags and optimizing turbo.json dependencies; claims to reduce build from ~4m45s to 2-3m and test from ~11m15s to 6-7m.

perf_labels.notes: Devin modified CI workflows multiple times (15 commits), eventually only keeping parallelism flags; PR closed by bot due to inactivity within 12 hours, no human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 112 changed lines across 7 files, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a typical CI tuning PR that is meant to be fast-tracked, but it was closed without merge due to lack of review engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No human reviewer participated; only bot activity (Devin integration notice, Vercel deployment). PR closed by Devin bot with 'inactivity for more than 7 days' message after only ~12 hours.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduces turbo build from ~4m45s to 2-3m and test from ~11m15s to 6-7m via parallelism flags and optimized task dependencies.
review_details.rejection_signals: Devin bot auto-closed with inactivity message; no maintainer interaction or performance validation.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: CI configuration changes require maintainer approval and CI validation; Devin iterated extensively (15 commits) but received no human review, leading to auto-close even though the changes were small and performance claims were narrative.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of code reading; review was never performed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR claims specific timing improvements but provides no CI run logs, benchmarks, or verification steps; no maintainer tested the changes.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without merge; no regression or fix cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Added --concurrency=10 --parallel flags to turbo build and test commands in package.json; attempted to add remote caching, topological ordering, and task dependency optimization in turbo.json but eventually reverted most changes except the parallelism flags. Also updated workspace dependency and tsconfig paths but reverted those as well.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Multiple revert commits indicate Devin's trial-and-error approach to resolve dependency and configuration issues; final state only has parallelism flags.
change_trajectory: Initial commits: add turbo remote caching, parallelism flags, and optimize test task dependencies.
Remove Vercel remote caching and add topological build ordering.
Attempt to fix dependency resolution with tsconfig paths and workspace dependency changes.
Remove invalid topological key, restore build dependencies, update lockfile.
Revert tsconfig paths and workspace dependency changes, keeping only parallelism flags.
Final commit: ensure only parallelism flags for build and test commands.
